Class DatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.database.DatabaseManager
public class DatabaseManager extends Object
Manages the MySQL database connection (Aiven cloud) and all database operations for persisting match results and querying the leaderboard. The connection is configured via a .env file (see .env.example). Falls back to localhost if .env is missing. Table schema (auto-created on init): match_results ( id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, nickname VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, score INTEGER NOT NULL, match_date DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, num_players INTEGER NOT NULL )

      public List<LeaderboardEntry> getLeaderboard(int numPlayers)
      Returns the full leaderboard for matches with a given number of players, ordered by score descending. Each entry includes the player's rank (position).
